subject: Bugbear Warrior
picture: All-ages fantasy coloring book page, portrait. Outline art only. A tall bugbear warrior drops through a broken dungeon ceiling, both feet off the floor. In both hands he holds one large spiked club raised to strike. The club head is a big spiked ball on a thick handle. He is not holding a ceiling beam. There is no weapon on the floor. There is no extra pole in the middle of the room. He is a large hairy goblinoid, not a troll: blunt snout, short pointed ears, fur in large clumps, simple hide armor. Through the broken ceiling you see wooden joists and floorboards of the room above, large simple shapes, plus a few broken stones. Closed wooden door on the back wall. One crate. One barrel. Large floor slabs. Block walls. No blank hole, no black blob, no gray puddle, no page frame.
